description: Add people from a people sheet to an existing campaign. Fills the campaign's cadence template with each person's name, company, role and signals. Skipped: rows already in the campaign; people the user's connected CRM already has (the result's crmKnown, with crmKnownReason saying how many and why); and people the user removed from this campaign before (the result's removedBefore, with removedBeforeReason saying how many and who), unless includeRemoved is true. Every row asked for is added in this one call (up to 1000, in batches of 25); a campaign has no size limit. Without rowIds, adds the sheet's people rows not yet in the campaign. Only adds people already in a sheet; it does not search for new people. Ids must be exact; none are guessed.

includeRemoved.description: True brings back people previously removed from this campaign (the ones a result reported in removedBefore). Leave it out or false to skip them.

rowIds.description: Optional exact sheet row ids, up to 1000. Omit to add every people row of the sheet not yet in the campaign.

name: add_prospects_to_campaign
title: Adicionar pessoas à campanha
